q.stem: A bull ELI is linked to a basket of two stocks, Stock B and Stock C. Both stocks have an initial spot price of $50. On the final valuation date, Stock B closes at $30 and Stock C closes at $45. Which statement correctly identifies the reference asset and its performance?
options: Stock C is the reference asset, with a performance of 90%.
Stock B is the reference asset, with a performance of 60%.
Stock B is the reference asset, with a performance of 40%.
Both stocks count equally, so the reference performance is 75%.
q.explanation:
Performance of a stock = closing price on final valuation day / initial spot price x 100%.
Stock B: $30 / $50 x 100% = 60%.
Stock C: $45 / $50 x 100% = 90%.
The reference asset is the worst-performing stock, which is Stock B (60% is lower than 90%).
q.source_quote: Stock B is the worst-performing stock.
